Acorn AM2BP, Smooth Iron Spear Tip Hook

The Spear Tip Hook is made out of iron with a smooth, matte black finish. A hook such as this is as useful in the kitchen as it is in the bathroom. A stylish way to hang a robe, towels, or even a lady's purse, it's a beautiful way to keep things off the floor in any room. The rustic styling makes it perfect for traditional decors.

Features and Specifications of the Smooth Iron Colonial Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 1-1/2"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screw.
